description: This file implements the CrossToolProtocol class which manages message-based communication between tools in a cross-process or cross-origin environment. It handles receiving various message types such as bug reports and timestamps, and also sending timestamp messages. It serves as a message handler and dispatcher for cross-tool communication in a web context.

classes.name: RemoteTool
classes.description: A helper class encapsulating a remote window and its origin for message passing.

classes.name: CrossToolProtocol
classes.description: Main class implementing the remote bug report, timestamp receiving, and timestamp sending interfaces. Handles message event listening, message processing, and callback invocation.

methods.name: setOnTimestampReceived
methods.description: Sets the callback to handle received timestamp messages.

methods.name: sendTimestamp
methods.description: Sends a timestamp message to the remote tool if available.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming message events, filters by origin, and dispatches messages based on type.

methods.name: onMessageBugreportReceived
methods.description: Processes a bug report message and invokes the callback with timestamp if present.

methods.name: onMessageTimestampReceived
